winner.text: Replace pointwise BCE with within-user pairwise BPR while retaining the factorization-machine architecture, user/item IDs, request-context fields, split, and evaluation protocol.
winner.rationale: The current scorer reaches GAUC 0.66891 and nDCG@5 0.53696, but the objective is ranking; pairwise training directly optimizes positive-over-negative ordering.
winner.exact_ablation: Ablate pointwise BCE training and use one sampled positive-negative pairwise BPR loss per eligible user, leaving model, features, split, and evaluation unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Increase approximately 0.003 to 0.010 by improving within-user positive-versus-negative ordering.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Increase approximately 0.002 to 0.008, with potentially larger gains for users whose current top-five retrieval is weak.

selection_rationale: Select within-user pairwise BPR. It directly aligns training with GAUC and nDCG@5, preserves the proven factorization-machine architecture, features, split, and evaluation protocol, and has low leakage risk with only moderate runtime risk. Its expected primary gain of 0.006 is competitive, confidence is higher than most larger-scope alternatives, and the Consultant ranked it first with utility 0.82.
